expected: each packet maps to exactly one work order
note: work orders must not lose or duplicate packet execution units

expected: each execution row maps to one packet and one work order
note: queue rows must be actionable from the work-order layer without ad hoc reconstruction

expected: critical work orders must be ranked first
note: critical blockers must be acted on before high-priority refinement work

expected: all work orders carry action, evidence, stop, boundary, and completion fields
note: manual execution must not rely on reviewer memory or whole-cube reconstruction
completion slots must not imply automatic package mutation or public release

expected: no URLs, emails, or phone-like details in execution surfaces
note: actionable work surfaces must remain non-operational and non-contact-bearing

expected: each work order has explicit no-public-permission boundary
note: manual execution cannot be confused with public publication or referral permission

expected: work order order follows packet order exactly
note: ordering refactor must not silently reorder packets outside the audited packet ranking
